verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs say the Console API is a CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without the web UI, which is a direct first-party claim of UI parity. The separate HTTP API also covers runtime evaluation and event logging, and an official MCP server exposes Statsig to agent tools. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation showing that every UI action is covered, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
